root_cause: The system is experiencing two critical failures: 1) Node 'nj1p-she-ora1' has severe hardware-level CPU thermal throttling with over 34,000 recorded events, indicating a cooling failure. 2) The custom OCF agent 'oracle_traiana' is not standard-compliant, failing the mandatory 'meta-data' query with rc=3, which breaks cluster resource management.
likely_causes: Physical cooling failure (fan/heatsink) or dust accumulation on nj1p-she-ora1.
The 'oracle_traiana' script lacks the required 'meta-data' case logic in its argument handling.
Degraded thermal paste or high ambient temperature in the datacenter.
A broken version of the 'oracle_traiana' script was deployed to production.

evidence.line: kernel: CPU15: Core temperature above threshold, cpu clock throttled (total events = 33955)
crmd: info: action_synced_wait: Managed oracle_traiana_meta-data_0 process 9899 exited with rc=3
oracle_traiana(oracle_traiana)[2381]: ERROR: meta-data: action not supported

remediation: Hardware: Inspect fans/heatsink on nj1p-she-ora1; run 'ipmitool sdr type Temperature' for real-time diagnostics.
Software: Update the 'oracle_traiana' script to handle the 'meta-data' action and output valid OCF XML.
Cleanup: Run 'pcs resource refresh instance_lhprod' and 'pcs resource cleanup instance_lhprod' after script fixes.
Maintenance: Clean dust from server chassis and re-apply thermal paste if temperatures remain high.
